canvasBetaWelcome.title: Welcome to waoowaoo Beta ✨
canvasBetaWelcome.body: We're exploring a new way to create: an Agent that becomes your directing partner, understands your ideas, shapes each scene, and helps turn inspiration into something real. This is still evolving, and you may encounter a few rough edges along the way—but we'll keep polishing every one of them. Thank you for being among the first to explore the future of Agent-powered directing with us.
